item.text:
This pass added two pieces of evidence.

**F26 — PreAccept broadcasts the wrong sequence.** `startPhase1` stores the computed `Seq` on the leader’s instance, but leader bookkeeping is created with `-1`; the broadcast reads that field. The focused test fails with `PreAccept.Seq=-1, leader instance Seq=0` ([output](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/audit_preaccept_seq_output.txt)). `diagnostic_fix14/` passes the computed sequence and keeps the cluster controls and 500-seed campaign at zero divergence ([output](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/diagnostic_fix14_seq_output.txt)).

**Seed 706 — 2-PUT/3-NOOP split.** Before recovery, replicas 0 and 2 were COMMITTED with the PUT, replica 1 was PREACCEPTED, and 3–4 had no instance; recovery by 3 left 0/2 with PUT and committed NOOP on 1/3/4 ([output](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/audit_random_fault_seed706_output.txt)). `diagnostic_fix14/` commits the PUT on all five, confirming the same F1 masking chain ([output](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/diagnostic_fix14_seed706_output.txt)).

The 1,000-seed loss classifier also confirms that the all-NOOP outcomes contain no fast-path-chosen candidate: captured holder distribution is `{1:36, 2:324, 3:222}`, fixed `{1:36, 2:146}`, and every three-holder case has differing `seq` values. The safety signal remains the 11 captured mixed divergences versus 0 in the fixed stack.

The report now documents **26 findings**; the captured suite remains **41 failing finding tests and 5 passing controls**, with the source unchanged.
